claim: Patchline ships a provable kill-switch that halts all autonomy and leaves the repo in a safe state. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the kill-switch claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make provable-kill-switch-gate`.
